elements.content: Grandpa loves to work. He wakes up at 5 o’clock every morning. What does he do so early in the morning? He cleans the street. He often says, “I’m happy that I can work. I feel good that my work makes others happy, too.” My grandpa is the best. I hope I can be like him when I grow up. But I don’t know if I could get up early.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 早起
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 爷爷喜欢工作。他每天早上 5 点起床。他一大早都在做什么？他打扫街道。他经常说：“我很高兴我能工作。我很高兴我的工作也让别人快乐。”我爷爷是最好的。我希望我长大后能像他一样。但我不知道我是否能早起。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
